hooks.text: Spacecraft engines successfully fired after thirty-seven years of freezing sleep.
Can a spacecraft fire engines that have been frozen for thirty-seven years?
Thirty-seven years of freezing sleep could not stop these spacecraft thrusters.

title: The Spaceship Engines That Woke Up After 37 Years
description: In 2017, NASA engineers successfully fired Voyager 1's backup thrusters after they sat completely unused in deep space for 37 years.

beats.text: Spacecraft engines successfully fired after thirty-seven years of freezing sleep.
beats.visual: illustration of the Voyager 1 spacecraft drifting in deep space, NASA, 2013

beats.text: NASA launched Voyager 1 in 1977 to explore the outer edge of our cosmic neighborhood.
beats.visual: Titan IIIE rocket launching from Cape Canaveral carrying Voyager 1, 1977
queries: Titan III Centaur launch Cape Canaveral 1977

beats.text: Built by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the probe captured stunning flybys of Jupiter and Saturn.
beats.visual: Jupiter and its Great Red Spot photographed by Voyager 1, 1979

beats.text: Powered by plutonium-238 fuel, Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space in August 2012.
beats.visual: artist's concept of Voyager 1 crossing the heliopause into interstellar space, NASA, 2012
queries: Voyager interstellar medium artist concept NASA

beats.text: The spacecraft transmits scientific data to Earth using NASA's Deep Space Network.
beats.visual: Goldstone Deep Space Network antenna dish in California, 2010
queries: Goldstone Deep Space Network antenna dish
Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex dish

beats.text: By 2017, its primary orientation thrusters were degrading, threatening to silence the probe forever.
beats.visual: illustration of the Voyager 1 probe showing its high gain antenna, NASA

beats.text: Engineers decided to test backup trajectory correction thrusters that had sat dormant since 1980.
beats.visual: NASA engineers working on a Voyager spacecraft model at JPL, 1970s

beats.text: In November 2017, the tiny backup engines ignited perfectly across billions of miles.
beats.visual: concept illustration of Voyager firing thrusters in the deep interstellar void, NASA
queries: Voyager interstellar medium artist concept NASA

beats.text: Deep in the interstellar cold, the legendary voyager proved it was still ready to wake up.
beats.visual: artist concept of Voyager 1 in interstellar space with distant sun, NASA, 2013
queries: Voyager interstellar medium artist concept NASA
